| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100% (351/351, 0 nulls) | one complete book or one volume of a multi-volume work. Begins with a PG header remnant (title line, then a line ending in ` ***`), often a `Produced by …` credit, then a bilingual EN/EL transcription note, then the book |
